Samuel,

I am interested in attending the presentation and would like to sign up. The topic of Project Wavesurge: An Overview sounds informative, and I believe it would be beneficial to learn more about our water management systems. Could you please add my name to the list? I have reviewed the details on our intranet page, https://www.lakeshoreutilities.gov/employee-resources, and I am looking forward to hearing Kelly White's insights on Thursday, November 13, 2025. If there are any updates or changes, please let me know by the end of the day Tuesday, November 11, 2025.

Regards,
